Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.

THIS AGENDA HAS BEEN AMENDED TO INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING NOTICE:
This meeting is being held pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 issued by California Governor Gavin Newsom on March 12, 2020 to further the State's efforts to control the spread of COVID-19 Coronavirus. Planning Commissioners will attend and participate by teleconference/virtual meeting. Members of the public may also attend by teleconference in order to observe and provide public comment during the meeting. The meeting will not be livestreamed. If you wish to participate, the following process must be followed.
- Thursday, May 20 @ NOON - written correspondence is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org If you require a physical letter, it may be mailed to or dropped off at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274. Correspondence received by this deadline will be posted online with the staff report.
- Wednesday, May 26 @ NOON - correspondence received by this time will be forwarded to the board and posted online as late correspondence. Email your letter to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org or mail or drop off your letter at City Hall at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274. Correspondence received after this deadline will be forwarded to the committee at the start of the meeting.
- Wednesday, May 26 @ NOON - if you wish to present any visual aids such as a PowerPoint or photos during your public comment period, a PDF is due to PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org
- Wednesday, May 26 @ 6:30 p.m. - if you wish to speak during the meeting, you must email PlanningCommissionMeeting@PVEstates.org with (1) your name, (2) the project address on which you'd like to speak, and (3) the phone number and/or Zoom name from which you will be calling in to the meeting. This will replace the in-person speaker cards.
- As soon as possible - To invite Commissioners to view impacts from your home, submit a request in writing to appointments@PVEstates.org.
The meeting will begin promptly at 6:30 p.m. so please prepare and join the meeting in advance of 6:30 p.m. You will be muted upon entry. The host will unmute you when it is your turn to speak. Each member of the public is allotted 3 minutes maximum to present.
The City thanks you for your patience and understanding as we do our best to carry on the public process given current circumstances.

MEMORANDUM
  Agenda Item #:  10
  Meeting Date: 6/15/21

TO:  PLANNING COMMISSION

FROM:  BRIANNA RINDGE, COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR

SUBJECT:  PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS OF MAY 26, 2021

DATE:  JUNE 15, 2021

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present:  Planning Commissioners Walker, Lazzaro, Criley, and Nendick
Absent:  Planning Commissioner Wade
Also present: Community Development Director Brianna Rindge, Planner Brenna
  Wengert, City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

  Speakers: None

CONSENT

1.  NC-1560R-21/M-1437-21;  (RESOLUTION  NO.  PCR-2021-1233);
  Neighborhood Compatibility Revision and Miscellaneous applications to remove a
  previously adopted condition of approval regarding the sewer easement and walls
  exceeding 42” within the front yard setback at the single-family residence located
  at 916 Via Del Monte. Lot 6, Block 1634, Tract 7142. This project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant: Eric Buhrer, 55 S. Lake Ave Ste 600, Pasadena, CA 91101
  Owner: Grandway USDEV 1-C, LLC

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (4-0 in
  favor; Wade absent) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 19. A
  licensed survey of the building height shall be completed and submitted to the City

June 15, 2021 Planning Commission Meeting  City of Palos Verdes Estates
   to verify compliance with the approved building height for the subject lot; 20. The
  project creates, adds or replaces more than 10,000 square feet of impervious surface
  and portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project
  shall comply with the City’s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth
  in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; and 21. A standard urban stormwater
  mitigation plan (SUSMP), shall be prepared, approved by the City Engineer, and
  implemented for the project.

2.  NC-1697-21/G-1650-21/M-1445-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1234);
  Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading, and Miscellaneous applications for
  additions to the single-family residence located at 1716 Via Boronada. Lot 11,
  Block 1373, Tract 6689. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Kristi Skelton, 4752 Naytura Ridge, Laurel, MT 59044
  Owner: Annie & Sebastien Wickert

  Action: Criley moved and Lazzaro seconded to approve the application (4-0 in
  favor; Wade absent) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 19. The
  driveway shall be constructed per City Standards; and 20. The existing non-standard
  encroachments, stairs, shall be removed from the right-of-way.

OLD BUSINESS

3.  NC-1698-21/M-1443-21; (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2021-1229); Neighborhood
  Compatibility and Miscellaneous applications for additions to the single-family
  residence located at 785 Via Somonte. Lot 18, Block 1538, Tract 6884. This project
  is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14,
  Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Michael Spencer, 226 S Beverly Dr #220, Beverly Hills, CA 90212
  Owner: Tim & Kavita Lesser
  Speakers: Paul Robson, Nancy Robson, Joan Ernster, Joan Paige Deary, Jennifer
  Ernster, Lori Ernster, Garrett Matsunaga, Kartik Ananth, Ginger Eaton, Kevin
  Theodora, Shaun Tucker

  Action: Nendick moved and Walker seconded to approve the application (3-0 in
  favor; Lazzaro recused; Wade absent) with standard conditions and the following
  conditions: 19. Curb, per City Standards, shall be constructed along the frontage at
  the discretion of the City Engineer; 20. Driveway and driveway apron shall be
  constructed per City Standards; 21. No permanent structure shall be constructed
  along an easement; 22. The stepping stones, a nonstandard encroachment, located
  along the right-of-way, shall be removed; 23. The roof over the master wing shall
  be a hipped roof design; 24. The roof pitch shall be 3:12; 25. The second floor plate
  height shall be reduced to 9’-6”; 26. The west side of the bay window seat off the
  master bedroom shall be removed so that the bay window seat shall protrude from

  Speakers: Sandy Walia, David Moss, Veronica Sigal

  Applicant: Luis de Moraes, 116 S Catalina Ave Ste 102, Redondo Beach, CA 90277
